episode_goal: Establish mutual suspicion and prove the new threat knows Mara's past.
entry_state: Mara's professional reputation remains damaged; she accepts one tightly limited security assessment.
central_conflict: Elias refuses to reveal why she was selected while a locked-room alarm indicates an insider breach.
protagonist_decision: Mara overrides Elias's lockdown and enters the compromised archive herself.
reveal: The intruder left audio from Mara's failed first negotiation.
emotional_movement: Controlled detachment → personal alarm → defiant focus.
exit_state: Mara knows the contract targets her as well as Elias; Elias knows she will disobey him to pursue evidence.
cliffhanger: The recording includes Elias's voice giving an order he claims he never made.

episode_goal: Turn suspicion into a testable conflict and expose the cost of Elias's secrecy.
entry_state: Mara suspects Elias influenced her first case; the archive remains compromised.
central_conflict: Elias offers the unredacted recording only if Mara follows his security protocol, which would surrender her independent exit route.
protagonist_decision: Mara creates and shares a verifiable evidence escrow instead of accepting either blind trust or withdrawal.
reveal: Elias's recorded order was spliced from a later rescue operation.
payoff_refs: Partial payoff of `DR-S2`: the recording is manipulated, but the editor remains unknown.
exit_state: Mara and Elias share evidence under mutual controls; the insider learns their escrow location.
cliffhanger: Mara's private exit code opens the evidence vault from inside the house.

episode_goal: Break the fragile alliance, then make Mara choose an action with personal risk.
entry_state: Evidence has been accessed using Mara's code; Elias has reason to suspect her.
central_conflict: Elias confines access to the estate while Mara must prove the code was copied without accepting detention.
protagonist_decision: Mara triggers the disabled panic system to publish its hidden diagnostic log, risking exposure of her own earlier procedural violation.
reveal: Security chief Nolan disabled the panic button and copied Mara's code during onboarding.
exit_state: Nolan is identified but controls the public narrative; Mara's old violation is now discoverable.
cliffhanger: Nolan releases edited footage framing Mara and Elias as co-conspirators.

episode_goal: Resolve the framed-crisis mystery through reciprocal, voluntary sacrifice.
entry_state: Mara and Elias face public accusation; Nolan expects them to protect themselves separately.
central_conflict: Clearing Mara requires Elias to expose family crimes; stopping Nolan requires Mara to disclose her own mistake.
protagonist_decision: Mara releases the full escrow with her violation included, forcing all evidence into the same public record.
reveal: Nolan created the original crisis to manufacture dependence on his security operation.
exit_state: Nolan is exposed; both leads lose institutional protection but retain agency and verified trust.
cliffhanger: Elias offers a new partnership with explicit exit terms, and Mara chooses to read them rather than walk away.
